newsitem.title: USA: United Technologies Corp Q4 earnings summary.
newsitem.headline: United Technologies Corp Q4 earnings summary.

text.p: (All data above 000s except per share numbers)
NOTES: Company announced a two-for-one stock split September 30 that was paid December 10 as a stock dividend.

In 1996 Q2, company changed classification of sales associated with Pratt & Whitneys strategic alliances and related arrangements on engine programs. 1995 amounts have not been reclassified, but impact would have been cut in revenues and cost of sales in Q4 and year ended December 31, 1995 of about $100 million and $400 million, respectively.

Beginning January 1, 1997, international operating subsidiaries, generally included in consolidated financial statements based on fiscal years ending November 30, will be included in consolidated financial statements based on fiscal years ending December 31. If this change had been made effective January 1, 1996, the estimated impact would have been an increase in first quarter results and a decrease in fourth quarter results, with no significant impact on the full year.
